column1: # Babi Lighthouse: workers, injured guards, Sheba's rescue, the sealed door and the ruins.

column3: It seems to be locked.{end_wait}
No order to resume work.\nPerhaps we have been given\na day to catch our breath.{end_wait}
Strangers entered the\nruins. Faran followed\nthem inside.{end_wait}

Babi chose a strange
place for his lighthouse.{page_break}Perhaps the old ruins
made a convenient
foundation.{end_wait}

Cutting and hauling
these stones is hard
work.{page_break}If Babi wants it built
faster, he can come
and lift them himself.{end_wait}

There was a fight here.
Some people were taken
afterward.{page_break}A terrible business,
but at least the work
has stopped for now.{end_wait}

If Faran followed them,
this is serious.{page_break}If the trouble spreads,
we may never finish
the lighthouse.{end_wait}

Why force the work to
move so quickly?{page_break}Perhaps Babi wants more
than a beacon. Perhaps
he seeks power at sea.{end_wait}
Now that I remember,\nthere was a strange cave\nin the quarry.{end_wait}
They were{pause_20_skippable} terrifying.\nWe never stood a chance\nagainst them.{end_wait}

Only two of the six
actually fought us...{page_break}but those two were
strong enough to drive
all of us back.{end_wait}
They shoved us aside\nand continued toward\nthe lighthouse.{end_wait}

They burned everything
in their path. The ground
is still blackened.{page_break}Fire used against the
helpless is the mark
of a coward.{end_wait}

We started the fight,
but we were the ones
left broken.{page_break}What possessed us to
challenge people like
that?{end_wait}
The other four barely\nraised a hand. They\nseemed unwilling to fight.{end_wait}
What are they planning\nto do at Babi Lighthouse?\nWhy come here at all?{end_wait}

None of them carried
a torch.{page_break}The fire appeared from
nowhere. I still cannot
explain it.{end_wait}
You're certain they\npassed through this door?{end_wait}
Well? Does the door open?{end_wait}
Oh! Iodem...{end_wait}
Faran!{end_wait}
Will you go for us?{end_wait}
I am trusting you,\n{actor_name:1}. Open the door\nand prove I was right.{end_wait}

When I saw them, they
were already beyond the
door.{page_break}I swear it is true.
You have to believe me!{end_wait}

I'm sorry, but even
{actor_name:7} has never passed
through this door.{page_break}No one has ever found
a way to open it.{end_wait}
If you open this door,\nI will trust Iodem\nonce more.{end_wait}

I do not doubt you,
{actor_name:1}, but I fear
what waits beyond.{page_break}If this door stays shut,
we may lose her.{end_wait}

No one believes this door
can be opened. I am
starting to doubt it too.{page_break}I never saw them pass
through. I only heard
what others claimed.{end_wait}
What are they waiting for?{page_break}If they can open the door,\nthey must do it now.{end_wait}

This waiting is useless.
If we do not find
{actor_name:7} soon,{page_break}her life may be lost
beyond that door.{end_wait}
I hope the door opens.\nI will believe it when\nI see it.{end_wait}
The door!{end_wait}
Hey, the door's closing!{end_wait}
Why did it close?{end_wait}
This is true...{end_wait}
Please, {actor_name:1}. Bring\n{actor_name:7} back to us.\nWe have no one else.{end_wait}
The door opened...\nI never thought I would\nsee this happen.{end_wait}

It takes courage to
walk into danger when
you know what waits.{page_break}We will remain here.
Return to us safely.{end_wait}

I want to know what
lies beyond this door.{page_break}When this is over, I
may go and see it
for myself.{end_wait}

I am not afraid of
danger, but I would only
stand in your way.{page_break}Bring {actor_name:7} home.
That is all we ask.{end_wait}

If {actor_name:7} is harmed,
Tolbi and Lalivero will
become enemies.{page_break}We must not let that
happen. Too many lives
would be lost.{end_wait}
If this door opens,\nperhaps the rest of the\nruins can be reached.{end_wait}

The creatures here are
nothing compared with
what waits below.{page_break}I am glad the warriors
will face that danger
instead of me.{end_wait}
This wait is pointless...{page_break}{actor_name:7}'s life is in\ndanger. If they do not\nfind her soon...{end_wait}

I will not hinder
{actor_name:7}'s rescue.{page_break}From here, the rest is
for those warriors
to decide.{end_wait}
The way opens to those\nwho can see beyond\nwhat their eyes reveal.{end_wait}

column1: # Sequential dialogue in Faran's first appeal and the sealed-door explanation.

column3: I saw them enter. The\nstone door opened for them.{end_wait}
I tried to move it.\nIt will not give.{end_wait}
I told you. This door\nhas never opened for us.{end_wait}
If it could be opened,\nwe would have entered\nthe ruins long ago.{end_wait}
But I saw them pass\nthrough it. I know\nwhat I witnessed.{end_wait}
No one has ever passed\nthrough that door. What\nproof do you have?{end_wait}
I am{pause_20_skippable} sorry about\n{actor_name:7}...{end_wait}
Why did this have to\nhappen to her?{end_wait}
Are {actor_name:5} and the others\nbeyond this door?{end_wait}
If they passed through,\nthey are beyond it now...{end_wait}
Then we can follow them.\nWe only need a way\nthrough.{end_now}
There is no one else\nwho can go after them.{end_wait}
Iodem, who are these\npeople?{end_wait}

They came from the far
north.{page_break}They followed the ones
who took {actor_name:7} all
the way here.{end_wait}
They pursued that group\nall the way from the\nnorth?{end_wait}
Yes. They are dangerous.\nWe have seen what they\ncan do.{end_wait}
Their power is terrible...\nAnd whatever they seek,\nit cannot be good.{end_wait}
Then we are the ones\nwho must stop them.{end_wait}
You believe you can\nstop them?{end_now}
Confidence is not enough.\nWhat can you actually\ndo against them?{end_wait}
Not with that attitude.\nYou will need more\nthan courage.{end_wait}
I have never heard you\nspeak so harshly, Faran.{end_wait}

What do you expect?
With {actor_name:7}'s life
at stake...{page_break}you ask me to trust
her rescue to children?{end_wait}
If you want my trust,\nyou must give me a\nreason to believe you.{end_wait}
Then show us what\nyou can do. Prove that\nyou can follow them.{end_wait}
Can you cross the same\npath they took?{end_now}
Your confidence proves\nnothing until you show\nus your strength.{end_wait}
There is no other way.\nYou will have to try.{end_wait}
Iodem asks only that\nyou stand back and\nwatch.{end_wait}
Then show us what\nyou can do.{end_wait}
The door moved! It\nactually opened!{end_wait}
After all these years...\nIt truly opened.{end_wait}
How did you manage\nto open it?{end_wait}
I cannot explain it.\nOur Psynergy answered\nwhere strength could not.{end_wait}
We did it because{pause_20_skippable}{pause_20_skippable}\nwe are who we are!{end_wait}
There is no time\nfor explanations now.{end_wait}
We can answer your\nquestions later. Sheba\nis still in danger.{end_wait}
Then go. Do not waste\nanother moment. Bring\n{actor_name:7} back to us.{end_wait}
Come, Faran. We must\nreach {actor_name:7} before\nit is too late.{end_wait}
Why would the door\nclose again?{end_wait}
It is meant to keep out\nthose who have no\nPsynergy.{end_wait}
Anyone without Psynergy\nwould be in danger\nbeyond that door.{end_wait}
Then leave the rest\nto us. We will go on.{end_wait}
You expect us to remain\nhere and do nothing?{end_now}
We cannot open the door.\nFollowing you would only\nput you at risk.{end_wait}
The door will not admit\nus. We cannot follow\nyou beyond it.{end_wait}
But we cannot leave\n{actor_name:7} in their hands,\neven if it is dangerous.{end_wait}
Their strength is far\nbeyond anything you\nhave faced.{end_wait}
Without that power,\nwe cannot pass through?{end_now}
That is what the door\nhas made clear.{end_wait}
What you witnessed was\nonly a fraction of\ntheir true strength.{end_wait}
If we followed, we\nwould only become\nanother burden.{end_wait}
Then {actor_name:7}'s life\nrests in your hands.{end_wait}
Bring {actor_name:7} home safely.\nDo not fail her.{end_wait}
Go now, {actor_name:1}.\nWe will wait for your\nreturn.{end_wait}
